{{Quote|You have the morning to perform breathing exercises, acclimatize to the altitude. After lunch your training begins. This afternoon, Force breathing.''"<br />"''Breathing? I thought this was the Martial Arts temple.|Master Tave and Dalien Brock|<ref name="Into the Void" />}}
'''Stav Kesh''', the '''Temple of Martial Arts''', was one of the nine [[Je'daii Temples]] of the [[Je'daii Order]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. A temple-[[City/Legends|city]] fashioned from [[Sandstone/Legends|sandstone]], Stav Kesh was built on the slopes and peak of a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] in the [[Ice Giant Range]], a mountain range on Tython's continent of [[Kato Zakar]], and it sat above where the [[Tho Yor]] pyramid [[Starship/Legends|ship]] that had brought the first pilgrims to the Ice Giants in [[36,453 BBY]] was buried in the mountainside. Constructed by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[36,019 BBY]], Stav Kesh was one of the stops along the [[Great Journey]] that all [[Je'daii Journeyer]]s took, and its inhabitants and [[Je'daii Temple Master|Temple Master]] taught martial arts, weapon combat, and other forms of combat to all who came to the Temple.

==Description==
{{Quote|Your first training session in Stav Kesh is almost at an end. This evening you will prepare food, scrub the kitchens, and then return here to clear the training yard of snow and mud. You might also visit the Tho Yor and meditate for a while. Meditation is a part of fighting. Centering yourself, finding and ensuring your balance.|Master Tave|<ref name="Into the Void" />}}
[[File:Stav_Kesh.png|thumb|left|300px|Stav Kesh]]
Stav Kesh was a large stone temple-[[City/Legends|city]] located in the [[Ice Giant Range]],<ref name="DOTJ 6" /> a range of [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] on the continent of [[Kato Zakar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].<ref name="Into the Void" /> The [[Tho Yor]] pyramid [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that brought the first pilgrims to the Ice Giants in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[36,453 BBY]] buried itself in the mountains, and the [[Je'daii Order]] built their own temple structures nearer the summit. The primary parts of the Temple were two large structures built into the side of the mountain, with flat tops and sides that slanted down the mountain, and a cylindrical tower rose on the right side of the temple proper. Open courtyards for combat training took up much of Stav Kesh's upper exterior.<ref name="DOTJ 1">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 1]]</ref>

[[Sandstone/Legends|Sandstone]] buildings were constructed all the way up the mountain's slope, forming buttresses and cliffs of smooth stone, and windows and balconies dotted the surface of the mountains. A waterfall ran down the surface of the mountain and the city, and an incredibly long staircase ran from the plains below to the top of the temple. Canvas window shades and pennants of dozens of colors were also a common sight, and [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] had a particularly strong presence at Stav Kesh. A significant cave system existed beneath the Temple which was warmed by magma lakes, and the Je'daii maintained hydroponic gardens there where they grew fruits and vegetables.<ref name="Into the Void" />

==History==
{{Quote|No one can fight without balance.|Temple Master Rupe|<ref name="Into the Void" />}}
[[File:Training_at_Stav.png|thumb|right|300px|Je'daii training at Stav Kesh.]]
In 36,453 BBY, the [[Tho Yor Arrival]] occurred&mdash;the eight Tho Yor pyramid starships brought [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] philosophers, warriors, [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]], artists, and scholars of many [[Species/Legends|species]] from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to the planet Tython and scattered the pilgrims across the surface. One of the Tho Yor traveled to the Ice Giant Range, a range of mountains<ref name="DOTJ 1" /> on the continent of Kato Zakar,<ref name="Into the Void" /> and deposited its passengers before burying itself in the mountains.<ref name="DOTJ 1" /> By the year [[36,019 BBY]], Stav Kesh&mdash;the Temple of Martial Arts&mdash;had been constructed by the [[Je'daii Order]], as the pilgrims called themselves, and it was one of the nine [[Je'daii Temples]] that had been constructed around or near the seven other Tho Yor and the ninth and largest Tho Yor. By that [[Time/Legends|time]], the Je'daii had established the tradition of the [[Great Journey]], which saw young Je'daii known as [[Je'daii Journeyer]]s travel the surface of Tython and visit each temple.<ref name="Into the Void" />

Stav Kesh's inhabitants developed the martial arts form known as [[Alchaka]] while training to perfect their martial arts abilities and their connection to the Force. Many Je'daii jokingly claimed that Alchaka had been developed simply to keep warm at Stav Kesh. Weapons training was another discipline taught at the temple, and Stav Kesh tested the weapons developed by [[Vur Tepe]], the Je'daii Forge.<ref name="DOTJ 0" /> [[Rupe]] was the [[Je'daii Temple Master|Temple Master]] of Stav Kesh around the year [[27,987 BBY]], and Temple Master [[Vor'Dana]] became Temple Master sometime before [[26,012 BBY]]. Vor'Dana was still Temple Master by the year [[25,997 BBY]], and sometime during Vor'Dana's time as Temple Master the Je'daii fought and [[Death/Legends|killed]] thirteen [[Sand Assassin]]s in the [[Great Hall]], a structure built deep in the mountains.<ref name="Into the Void" />

By the year [[25,802 BBY]], the Temple Master of Stav Kesh was a [[Talid/Legends|Talid]] named [[Lha-Mi]], and the [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] [[Tave]] served as assistant Temple Master. One of the [[Je'daii Master]]s at Stav Kesh, the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Kin'ade]], developed a machine known as the [[Darrow sphere]] several years before that. The Darrow sphere, a predecessor to the later training [[Remote/Legends|remote]] used by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], was a small sphere that acted as a sparring partner for trainees and delivered stun charges on contact. The sphere saw significant use at Stav Kesh, and one of Kin'ade's students nicknamed the sphere "Je'daii's bane." In 25,802 BBY, the Journeyers [[Lanoree Brock|Lanoree]] and [[Dalien Brock]] arrived at Stav Kesh, and they joined a group of Journeyers who were already being trained by the Temple's instructors. During one training session with the Darrow sphere, Dalien Brock&mdash;who was not [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and in fact despised the Force itself&mdash;tried to use a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] against the sphere when he became fed up with it, and several trainees were almost killed in the chaos when the unskilled Brock opened fire aimlessly.<ref name="Into the Void" />

[[File:Tave_fighting.png|thumb|left|300px|Master Tave fighting Sek'nos Rath, Shae Koda, and Tasha Ryo.]]
Brock lied about the event when questioned, but despite his sister's protests, the Masters at the Temple could sense that Brock would never be a Je'daii and did not want to be one. The two spent several weeks at Stav Kesh before departing, and Dalien was trained separately by Master Tave when the other Journeyers were instructed by Kin'ade in the use of Force weapons. On the last day that the Brocks and several Journeyers spent at the temple, they were shown a demonstration fight between Lha-Mi and Tave in the Grand Hall before they were made to fight each other in practice bouts.<ref name="Into the Void" /> Tave and Lha-Mi were still serving at Stav Kesh by [[25,793 BBY]], when Tave oversaw the training of three Journeyers&mdash;[[Sek'nos Rath]], [[Tasha Ryo]], and [[Shae Koda]]&mdash;in the courtyards atop Stav Kesh.<ref name="DOTJ 6" />

==Behind the scenes==
Stav Kesh was first pictured in the [[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0|preview issue 0]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], and it appeared in both the [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|first]] and [[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 1|sixth]] issues as well as the tie-in novel ''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''.
